page.heading: A plan instead of surprises
body: Most IT costs are predictable. Laptops wear out, licences renew and warranties end. The trouble is that nobody writes it down, so each one arrives as a surprise.

We start by listing every device, licence and contract you have, with its age and renewal date. From that we build a roadmap: what to replace, when, and roughly what it will cost. You get a budget for the year ahead that you can take to the owner or the board.
Every quarter we meet for an hour. We look at what changed, what is coming up, and any risks we have spotted. You leave with a short list of decisions, not a pile of jargon.
We also help with cyber insurance forms and vendor quotes, so you can compare options with someone on your side.
page.plans: Quarterly IT review in Business and Complete. The yearly roadmap and budget in Complete.

faq.q: Is this a virtual CIO service?
faq.a: Close to it. A senior technician who knows your setup runs your reviews and builds your roadmap. It costs far less than a full-time IT manager.

faq.q: Do we have to buy what you recommend?
faq.a: No. We give you options with prices, and you decide. Some items you can buy anywhere.
Usually three years, reviewed every quarter and rebuilt each year.
